   - From \( f(14) + f(2) = 16 \), we get \( f(14) = 16 - 2 = 14 \).
   - From \( f(18) + f(14) = 25 \), we get \( f(18) = 25 - 14 = 11 \).
   - From \( f(46) + f(18) = 36 \), we get \( f(46) = 36 - 11 = 25 \).
   - From \( f(2002) + f(46) = 121 \), we get \( f(2002) = 121 - 25 = 96 \).

Thus, the value of \( f(2002) \) is \(\boxed{96}\).
